title: Deleting a site that never had a session folder reports its sessions as handled, not an incomplete cleanup
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout with TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/sites-route.test.mjs
S2: Read the test lines named in run.tests.
expect: DELETE /api/sites/:key with the dsh archive door answering 409 NO_SESSION_FOLDER answers {removed: true, host: true, repo: false, sessions: true, seats: true}, with no sessionsReason, after one ask.
A door answering SESSION_ACTIVE until the wait ends still answers sessions: false, sessionsReason: SESSION_ACTIVE.
evidence: 14/10/2026 on dev: deleting qaak13ds.tracy.site showed 'Removal not confirmed, Reason: NO_SESSION_FOLDER'; tracy-web logged "dev's dsh kept the sessions of /site/qaak13ds: NO_SESSION_FOLDER" and no --site-qaak13ds-- folder existed in sessions/ or sessions-archive/.
fence: tracy-web's reading of the dsh archive door answer; fake dsh door, real Postgres. Not a proof against a live dsh.

tests: DELETE /api/sites/:key: a site that never had a session folder reports its sessions as handled
DELETE /api/sites/:key: a turn dsh still reports running when the wait ends keeps its folder, and says so
